_readme: Bilingual labels for MINED tags — the tags tags_mine.py mints from a field's own values.
Keyed by the mined family key in data/tags.json (`kind`, `trade`, …), then by the raw value.
A value with no row here still gets a tag: a Thai value keeps its Thai and shows an RTGS
reading beside it, an English value is de-snaked. Writing a row replaces both with wording
a person chose. `python3 tags_mine.py -v` prints what has no row yet, commonest first.
